title: Commands
description: All invocable commands. Each entry maps a logical API name to a Tauri snake_case command name, plus parameter and return schemas.

logicalName.description: Logical command name used in API_CONTRACT.md and external documentation. Uses colon namespace convention (e.g. 'settings:get'). Stable across all frontends.

tauriCommandName.description: Tauri invoke command name in snake_case (e.g. 'settings_get'). Used by tauriBridge.ts to map logical names. Must be unique.

paramsSchema.description: JSON Schema for the command parameters. Empty object {} means no parameters.

patch.description: For settings_update only: partial settings object to merge

returnsSchema.description: JSON Schema for the command return value

deprecated.description: If true, this command will be removed in a future version
